name: OBR — published economic and behavioural effects of policy (AS2023–AB2025 packages, supply-side scorings, March 2026 decisions)
published: Per artifact, per fiscal event: 2023-11-22 (EFO Nov 2023), 2024-03-06 (EFO Mar 2024), 2024-10-30 (EFO Oct 2024), 2025-11-26 (EFO Nov 2025 and Briefing paper No.10), 2026-03-03 (EFO Mar 2026). Wayback snapshot timestamps are in raw/README.md and are NOT publication dates.

model.name: OBR policy scoring (demand multipliers + supply-side scorings)
model.method: Package demand effects via OBR fiscal multipliers; supply-side effects per measure via labour-supply elasticities (NICs, childcare, welfare conditionality), capital deepening (investment incentives, public investment) and TFP channels, scored against the pre-measures forecast baseline of each EFO round. Briefing Paper No.10 (Nov 2025) documents the framework and re-states every scored measure.
model.method_basis: EFO policy chapters/boxes AS2023-AB2025; OBR Briefing Paper No.10

baseline_key: Per row, per round: each package/measure is scored against that EFO round's PRE-MEASURES forecast (obr_pre_measures_<event>), which is a distinct named world per round — never the null current_law, and never shared across rounds. March 2026 Table B.1 is explicit in its own title that its counterfactual is the November 2025 Budget forecast (obr_november_2025_budget_forecast). Briefing paper No.10 further distinguishes the counterfactual KIND: tax and welfare measures are scored against their legislated-parameter counterfactual, DEL and regulatory measures against the pre-existing activity/spending baseline; each row carries that kind plus a locator. The March 2025 WCA reversal scores against the WCA-adjusted world the November 2023 reforms created.
period: Financial years 2023-24 to 2030-31 as published; briefing-paper supply-side impacts are single forecast-horizon numbers
coverage_note: Package GDP effects: AS2023 (by channel), SB2024 (by channel), AB2024 (by component AND by measure), AB2025 (by component). AB2025 CPI effects by measure. Per-measure supply-side impacts (percent of potential GDP, by channel) for every measure OBR has scored, SB2023-SS2025, from Briefing Paper No.10 Table 2.1. March 2026 total/direct/indirect effects of Government decisions on borrowing (nested, GBP). Counterpart compute (OBR emulator, PE-UK LSR, OG-UK) is issue #55 steps 2-3, not this build. Source reconciliation: the adapter reads 272 numeric cells and emits 266 claims + 6 deliberately dropped cells — the March 2026 Table B.1 memo line 'total effect of Government decisions on current budget deficit', which scores a different fiscal aggregate (current budget, not PSNB) and is therefore not laundered into these four metrics. The drop is tallied by the build and asserted by tests; a value line that is neither emitted nor a declared drop raises.
diagnosis_upstream: OBR scoring models are closed; divergence diagnoses classified as external-model issues become a comparison memo, not an upstream PR.

units.gdp_level_effect: percent_of_real_gdp — per cent deviation in the LEVEL of real GDP (or of an expenditure component)
units.cpi_inflation_effect: percentage_points — effect on CPI inflation, in pp
units.supply_side_impact: percent_of_potential_gdp — impact on POTENTIAL output, per cent of GDP
units.decisions_effect_on_borrowing: gbp_nominal — raw pounds (published in GBP billion), sign as published (positive increases borrowing)
